title: Law to study electrical capacity in older apartment buildings
summary: This bill would require the Department of Buildings, along with the Fire Department and the Department of Housing Preservation and Development, to study the electrical capacity of at least 500 older residential buildings under 50,000 square feet built before 1975. The study aims to identify buildings needing electrical panel upgrades to reduce fire risk. It would be conducted within one year of the law taking effect and every five years after, with results reported to the mayor and Council and posted online.
